hypothesis: Entering trading mode only when the 10-bar rolling ATR exceeds 30 pts (5-min bars) will filter out low-volatility choppy sessions and improve risk-adjusted returns.
notes: EXP-0002 FINDING-5: March ATR=37.58 (profitable), Jul ATR=19.58 (low return), Jun ATR=23.97. ATR filter is computable in real-time (no look-ahead). Combined with EXP-0003 range filter, this creates a two-condition regime gate. Test independently first, then combine with EXP-0003.
conclusion: HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. ATR regime filter is highly predictive of strategy edge. ATR>35: +1108% vs +376% baseline (3x), avg ₹2,131/trade vs ₹141 (15x), 104 trades vs 532. CRITICAL FINDING: Every month becomes positive or near-zero with ATR>35 filter. February flips from -37.2% to +74.4%. May flips from -12% to +3.5%. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: This is fully in-sample — the ATR threshold itself was selected by looking at results. MUST validate via walk-forward before trusting. regime_filter.rationale: ATR>30 gives best balance of trade count (168 = statistically meaningful) vs performance improvement (2.5x return, 7.9x avg P&L)
